factor_rounding.question: Gate G1 needs your choice on how the Today card's factor values are rounded. Your mock-ups show whole numbers ("14°C", "0 mm/h", "9 mph"), but the planner chose 1 decimal place ("15.0°C", "26.3 mph") on its own. Which should the app show?

negative_rounding.question: One small follow-up on whole-number rounding: how should negative temperatures that end in .5 round? The planner proposes rounding away from zero, so -2.5°C shows "-3°C", and a value that rounds to zero shows "0°C" with no minus sign.

back_button.question: Back button: on the Walks or Dog tab, should pressing the phone's Back button go to Today, and on Today leave the app? This is the usual Android bottom-navigation behaviour.

hour_labels.question: Hour labels on the 12-hour forecast strip: your mock-ups show 2-digit 24-hour labels ("09", "14"). Should they stay 24-hour even when the phone is set to 12-hour time?

long_names.question: A long dog name in the bottom navigation bar (the Dog tab label): may it wrap to two lines or be shortened with "…" on screen, as long as TalkBack always reads the full name?

hour_label_12h.question: Last one before G1: when the phone uses 12-hour time, how should the forecast strip's hour labels look? The planner proposes "2 pm", "12 am" (lowercase, space, no :00), matching the app's best-time text "3:00 pm".

test_changes_E1_E8.question: The design needs eight test changes that weren't on the spec's list of test changes (E1–E8). Most follow controls that moved: Home is replaced by the bottom bar, there's no Back button on the main tabs, and Delete is now inside a "More" menu. One follows wording you approved (D10). Only E1 changes what TalkBack reads: the hero card announcement adds the four factor values, as the spec's AC19 requires. Each new check is exact and at least as strict as the old one. Approve these test changes?

row_delete.question: The spec says the walk row's "More" menu "stays", but in the MVP each row actually has a Delete button directly on it. Criterion AC44 and the mock-ups need a "More" menu. Should Delete move into a "More" menu on each row?

history_back_test_move.question: The Walks tab will have no Back button, so the Walks-screen test "Back returns to the previous screen" can't stay as it is. Its check moves into the main navigation test, where the phone's Back button on Walks must return to Today (Today highlighted, app not closed). The new check is stricter, but the old test is removed from the Walks test file. Do you approve moving it?
history_back_test_move.context: Explicit owner approval for removing HistoryScreenTest back_returns_to_the_previous_screen (L270-276) and moving its check to NavigationTest AC35 (design attempt 3, E3); architect judged it within OD1, orchestrator asked anyway because a test is removed (CLAUDE.md)

t3_start_scroll_tests.question: Task 3 pins the Start walk button outside the scrolling area, as the spec requires (it must always be on screen). Four existing test lines first scroll to the button before tapping it, and scrolling now fails because there's nothing to scroll. These lines weren't in the approved list of test changes. The fix replaces "scroll to Start, then tap" with "check Start is visible without scrolling, then tap". That is stricter, because it also proves Start is on screen. Approve this change to the 4 lines?

ac66_screenshots.question: Gate G3 failed task 3 on one point only. The design says every screen task's PR (tasks 3-8) must include emulator screenshots in light and dark mode for the side-by-side comparison with your mock-ups (AC66), and none were taken. An Android emulator (Medium_Phone_API_37.0) is installed on this PC. How should we handle this?

t3_clipping.question: With no profile set up, the sensitivity line loses its first letter ("Jsing", "hange"). How should we fix it? Task 3 is on attempt 2 of 3, so fixing it here uses its last attempt.

t3_minor_diffs.question: Do the smaller differences need changing?
items: named title wraps to two lines

t5_test_edits.question: Task 5 needs your OK for two small test edits that aren't word-for-word on the approved list. (1) Adding a new route query means one fake test helper (HistoryViewModelTest ~L238) needs one extra line so it compiles. No check changes. (2) A walk-formats test (WalkFormatsTest L29) checks the Recording timer, which now shows seconds: "1:02" becomes "1:02:03". It's covered by the spec's approved timer change, but the design didn't name that file. It stays an exact check. Approve both?

t6_test_edits.question: Task 6 (Walks tab) needs three more test lines changed that weren't on the approved list. Two "This week" card checks in HistoryScreenTest (L163, L212) need the new card layout. They're the same change as the two approved lines next to them, just with non-zero values. One walk-detail navigation check in FullScreenDestinationsTest (L123-124) needs the new date format without the year. That's the same change as the approved AppFlowIntegrationTest row. Each new check is exact. Approve these three?

t6_dark_menu.question: In dark mode, the open "More" menu (with Delete) is almost the same colour as the walk rows behind it and has no visible shadow, so its edge blends into the list (see the dark screenshot). The design doesn't specify a menu colour. Should task 6 fix it?

t7_test_edits.question: Task 7 needs two test lines that aren't on the approved list, both because of wording you already approved. (1) FullScreenDestinationsTest L125 waits for the "Walk details" title, which the redesign removes. It would wait for the new date heading "Monday 19 October" instead. (2) LocationNeededTest L109 waits for the "Privacy" title, which becomes "Privacy & your data". It would wait for that instead. Both stay exact checks. Approve both?

t7_loading_test_and_clock.question: Task 7: one approved test change can't work as written. The Walk detail "loading" test was meant to check for the new date heading, but while loading there's no walk yet, so no date. Options: A) the loading test instead checks the old "Walk details" title is gone (the date heading is already checked in the loaded tests); B) turn the loading test into a loaded test (loses loading coverage). Also: the Walk detail test needs a fixed test clock so the "no year in the current year" rule doesn't break the tests on 1 Jan 2027 (setup only, no check changes). Which?

t7_map_attribution.question: On Walk detail, the details sheet overlaps the bottom of the map by 28 dp, which would cover the map's logo and info ("i") button. Map attribution must stay visible (an existing MVP check protects it). The developer plans to shrink the map's drawn area by 28 dp at the bottom so the logo and attribution sit above the sheet, and list it as a difference from your mock-up. OK?
